asof: Wars and their backers as of {as_of}. Deaths counted by the Uppsala Conflict Data Program from {win_from} to {win_to}.

glossary.UCDP: The Uppsala Conflict Data Program, a university project in Sweden that counts armed conflicts and the deaths in them, year by year.
glossary.armed conflict: A fight between a government and an opposing side in which at least {acd_bar} people died that year.
glossary.band: A range a death count falls in. {band_ranges}
glossary.armed group: A fighting force that is not the army of a state: a rebel movement, a militia, a gang, a jihadist group.
glossary.backer: A state, a group of states, or a force that runs part of a state, that helps one side from outside the war.
glossary.province: The first level of division inside a country. Some countries call them states or regions.
glossary.provisional: Not final. UCDP revises its latest years as more reports come in.

steps.title: How many wars?
steps.body: Guess how many wars were fought in the past year.
steps.reveal_note: KURT'S WORDS (2026-11-12). Do not edit the reveal, even on a language pass. He asked for "(UCDP)" after the full name. The numbers are tokens so they stay true to the data.
steps.reveal: How many wars are there? It depends who’s counting. The Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), a research group at a Swedish university, counted {ucdp_n} [[armed conflict|armed conflicts]] in {ucdp_year}. To make that list, a fight between a government and an opposing side has to cause at least {acd_bar} battle deaths in a year. {Ucdp_wars_word} of them reached {war_bar} battle deaths, which is UCDP’s line for calling something a war. This map shows {wars} wars, partly because it sometimes treats several of UCDP’s conflicts as one war.

steps.name: provinces
steps.title: Where the fighting is
steps.body: Shaded provinces show where the fighting was in the past year. In the Iran war, {eg_prov} are shaded, in {eg_countries} countries. The war began in {eg_start}. A [[province]] is shaded for ground fighting, sieges or an air campaign. {areas_drone}

sources.text: Province borders: Natural Earth, a public-domain map.

steps.name: deaths
steps.title: How many died
steps.body: The dots are all one size so far. Next they show deaths in the past year.

guess.question: Which of these three killed the most people in the past year?

steps.reveal: {top_name} had the most: {top_n}. UCDP counted {o1_n} in {o1_name} and {o2_n} in {o2_name}, from {win_from} to {win_to}. UCDP sorts deaths into three kinds, and each bar shows them. In {os_name}, {os_n} of the {os_total} were civilians killed deliberately. The dots now show deaths in three [[band|bands]].
steps.chart_caption: Deaths by war, {win_from} to {win_to}, UCDP's best count. Under each war that began before {win_from}: its count since it began.

sources.pick: Deaths are shown as a band

sources.text: Each war's count adds up UCDP's counts for the countries it covers, or for its named conflicts. The latest months are UCDP's early figures, which it has not yet fully reviewed.
The Iran war's {eg_n} leaves out one UCDP row: {eg_left_n} civilians killed by Iran's government in January 2026, before the war began. UCDP has marked that row for review.
The Iran war's {eg_n} includes {eg_before_n} deaths UCDP counted before the war began in {eg_start}, so its card in step 10, which counts from {eg_start}, is lower.

steps.name: who fights
steps.title: Who fights
steps.body: In the Iran war {eg_sides_word} sides fight: {eg_side_a} against {eg_side_b}. All {eg_parties_word} are [[state|states]]. Iran also has allies that are not states, such as Hezbollah and the Houthis. They are [[armed group|armed groups]]. Of the {ucdp_n} armed conflicts UCDP counted in {ucdp_year}, {interstate} were between states. In the other {intra}, a government fought an armed group.

steps.name: how do we know
steps.title: How do we know?
steps.body: The way a line is drawn shows how strong the public evidence for it is. The more broken the line, the weaker the evidence.

steps.name: force short of war
steps.title: Force short of war
steps.body: A hollow square marks force without sustained fighting: strikes, raids, seizures, a blockade. There are {squares} squares. {sq_us} are by the {us_name}. The squares carry no lines. Who helps each one is on its card on the full map. A square is shown when the state doing it has said so.

steps.name: every year
steps.title: Every year since {n_first}
steps.body: To look back, this chart uses UCDP's wider count of armed conflicts, back to {n_first}. In {ucdp_year} it counted {ucdp_n}, {n_phrase}. The five years to {avg_last_year} average {avg_latest} deaths a year on UCDP's best count. {avg_two} The last {prov_word} years are [[provisional]].

phrases.n_tie: as many as the highest year before it
phrases.n_else: more than in all but {n_above} years
phrases.avg_two: The five years to {avg_other_year} average {avg_other}. Those are the two highest of any five years since {d_first}. Of the {peak_total} deaths in {peak_year}, UCDP's best count puts {peak_top_n} in {peak_top_name}.
phrases.avg_else: The highest five years since {d_first} end in {avg_max_year}, at {avg_max} a year.

chart.bottom: Deaths a year, {d_first} to {d_last}. Bars: UCDP's best count. Line: five-year average.

sources.text: Every year on one chart, with the oil price and what each peak was, is on the level page.

steps.name: the {wars_word} wars
steps.title: The {wars_word} wars
steps.body: One card for each war. The dot shows its deaths in the past year. Next to it: the year it began and UCDP's count of the dead from then to {whole_to}, then how many sides fight and how many backers help. {old_n} of the {wars} began more than ten years ago. The oldest, {oldest_name}, has run {oldest_years} years. The strip shows how its lines are drawn, from on the record to alleged. {Tap} a card and the map goes there.

sources.text: The count since a war began adds UCDP's best count for every month from the war's first to {whole_to}, by the same rule as the past year's count and with all three kinds of death. The start month is this map's. UCDP dates several of these conflicts from decades earlier.
Each war's full card, with every line and source, is on the full map.
